meta.name: StudentPerks — Neo-Bold / Genjutsu grade
meta.description: Elevated bold-startup directory: ink borders + hard shadows, violet/lime, Space Grotesk display, now with a lazy WebGL point-cloud hero, GSAP scroll choreography and motion-design micro-interactions. Fast, light+dark, reduced-motion safe.

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast, bold ink borders, one inverted dark hero band

typography.font_style_notes: geometric grotesk display with tight tracking; neutral humanist body

layout.alignment_tendency: mixed — left-strong hero, grid content, sidebar directory

shape.divider_style: 2px dashed soft, or 3px solid ink accents

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) expo-out; cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) back for pops
motion.entrance_pattern: fade + translateY(16px) + optional clip-reveal, word/stagger on hero
motion.philosophy: cinematic but restrained; scroll-choreographed; never blocks content; reduced-motion disables

components.button_style: bold pill, 2px ink border, hard shadow, press = translate to 0 + magnetic hover
components.card_style: white card, 2px ink border, hard shadow, hover lift(-3px)+bigger shadow
components.navigation_pattern: sticky blurred header, faceted left rail on directory
components.component_notes: score badge (green/lime/grey tiers), solid uppercase badges

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a well-run startup marketplace / risograph poster

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (marker, hard shadow, one WebGL hero)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around hero, dense in directory
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element then progressive reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle grain on dark band only

imagery.graphic_elements: brand logos, line icons, hard shadows, lime marker
imagery.pattern_usage: diagonal hatch on ad slots, grain on hero
imagery.image_shape: rounded-square logo tiles with ink border

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: lift + shadow grow; magnetic on primary CTA
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy with a touch of back-ease bounce

overview.fallback_strategy: static gradient snapshot; reduced-motion + mobile + save-data disable WebGL

background_effects.type: mesh-gradient + fine grain on the inverted hero band
background_effects.description: violet→ink radial glow with animated noise, very subtle

particle_systems.description: hero WebGL: a distorted sphere of glowing points drifting, reacting to pointer + scroll

3d_elements.type: abstract-geometry (point cloud); GLTF slot available via threejs-loaders
3d_elements.description: asset-free premium hero object; swap in a GLTF model later if desired

shader_effects.description: vertex simplex displacement, fragment radial soft point + depth gradient

text_effects.description: hero headline words rise + fade in with stagger; lime marker draws under keyword

cursor_effects.description: primary CTAs subtly pull toward cursor within a small radius

svg_animations.description: lime marker underline draws on hero keyword via scaleX

visual_effects.composite_notes: WebGL hero is the single heavy effect and is gated: only inits on desktop, pointer:fine, no prefers-reduced-motion, no save-data, and after first paint (lazy). Everything else is GSAP/CSS and degrades to static. Core directory content is fully SSR and readable with JS disabled.
